main.description: Permissions for the main Streamarr desktop window (the UI). It gets core defaults and the opener plugin only: all native work - playback, profiles, tokens, filesystem - is reachable solely through the invoke commands in src/commands, each of which validates its own arguments. See plan task 1.2.

player.description: Permissions for the native player window. It hosts no web content and must therefore grant the WebView nothing: no core commands, no plugins, no filesystem. The window exists so the video surface has a toplevel of its own (spike 0.2); the shell draws into it directly.
